member.name: T:CleanArchitecture.WebApi.Controllers.v1.AdminCollectionController
member.summary: Admin-only collection endpoints. No ownership checks are enforced — admins can view, edit, and delete any user's collections. SECURITY: Every action requires the "Admin" role.

member.name: T:CleanArchitecture.WebApi.Controllers.v1.TagController
member.summary: This controller handles all requests related to Tags (labels like Nature, Food, Historical). Tags are flexible labels that can be attached to Routes. A Route can have multiple Tags (many-to-many relationship).

member.name: T:CleanArchitecture.WebApi.Controllers.v1.UserCollectionController
member.summary: User-facing collection endpoints. All actions are scoped to the authenticated user. The user ID is always extracted from the JWT "uid" claim — never passed as a parameter. Also exposes /api/me/saved-routes as a mobile-friendly shortcut for the default "Saved Routes" collection.
